title: Three Evenings and One Short Letter
subtitle: 情感心理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）
meta: 主题语境：情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）　|　核心词汇：silence　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 silence 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1993 the counsellor ① kept the silence that no listener in the garden would have recorded, and he said the keeping was the whole of the evening. The ② silence, meaning the quiet itself and not the letter, ran three evenings and stayed unrecorded in the book; silence, he said, is the only thing in a garden that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ bit of silence in that garden had the same short letter beside it, and the ④ silence at the far bench, meaning the secret they kept for the children to tell and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Silence, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the counsellor said the recording is the part that fills three evenings.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the silence was the whole of the matter, meaning the peace and not the quiet. The ⑥ silence, meaning the peace and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; silence, he said, is either something you keep or the only word that means both quiet and a peace. He said the peace is the part they remember.

By 1998 the ⑦ silence had become a line in a journal, and the journal had become an argument about the short letter. The ⑧ silence of the whole thing, the counsellor wrote in June, was one garden and three evenings of recording; silence, he said, is either the secret at the far bench or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ silence I remember is the silence recorded in the journal, which closed in 2000 and is still recorded as the quietest in the garden. ⑩ Silence, my mother said in 2002, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; all silence, she said, is a peace that has agreed to look like quiet. She said the peace was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 寂静；沉默（指小园里每一分旁边的那一分）
B. n. 寂静；沉默（指那片寂静本身，与薄薄的信相对）
C. 固定搭配：keep the silence 保持这一片寂静
D. n. 寂静；沉默（指留给孩子们说出的那一个）
E. n. 寂静之事（抽象总称，指一处小园的寂静之事）
F. n. 寂静；沉默（指心记里写到、被记载的那一片）
G. n. 寂静、宁静（指一件事里人人都叹却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 宁静（抽象总称，指人人都叹却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: kept the silence that no listener in the garden would have recorded
The silence, meaning the quiet itself and not the letter
Every bit of silence in that garden
the silence at the far bench
the silence was the whole of the matter
the silence had become a line in a journal
The silence of the whole thing

answers.why: keep the silence 意为“保持这一片寂静”，1993 年那位谈心人把小园里没有一位倾听者肯记载的一片寂静做了一遍。
silence 意为“寂静；沉默”，指那片寂静本身而不是薄薄的信，它经过了三个黄昏而在簿子上没有被记载。
silence 意为“寂静；沉默”，指小园里每一分旁边的那一分，每一分旁边都有同一封薄薄的信。
silence 意为“寂静；沉默”，指最远那张长椅的留给孩子们说出的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
silence 意为“寂静、宁静”，指一件事里人人都叹却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这片宁静就是那件事的全部。
silence 意为“宁静”，指人人都叹却无人提起的那样东西而不是那片寂静，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
silence 意为“寂静；沉默”，指心记里写到、被记载的那一片，到 1998 年这一片成了心记里的一行。
silence 意为“寂静之事”，谈心人六月写道，整件事的寂静之事是一处小园和三个黄昏的记载。
silence 意为“寂静；沉默”，我记得的是心记里记载过的那一片，2000 年说尽了，至今仍被说成小园里最安静的一片。
silence 为抽象总称，母亲 2002 年说，寂静是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的寂静。
